verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party export of Auth data in open formats. Linking auth data to your own tables via triggers and foreign keys is a developer building block. Self-hosting is a related but different capability. The community remark that copying user data out is trivial describes a user-side workaround. None of these earn credit for a data-export-and-leave story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
